descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S23 「真 iPhone 和 Android：Copy Text 粘贴出同样的列表，没有分享面板或邮件 app；手机时钟错了」 Real iPhone and Android: Copy Text pastes the same list, no share sheet or mail app; wrong phone clock

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • G2 UAT 3.8: the stored doneAt, the day/visit shown on a closed task and the date header of the screen and of Copy Text follow server time, not the device clock（UAT 3.8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given iOS and Android builds pointed at a non-dev backend, the S01/S02 census; then the phone clock set one day ahead

When Tap Copy Text and paste into Notes; look for any share or mail path; with the wrong clock, complete a task and Copy Text again

Then The pasted text matches the screen's grouping; no share sheet, mail app or mailto opens; with the wrong clock the completed task's day/visit and the copy's date header show the server's day (3.8)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Tester compares the paste with the S01/S02 checkpoints (U3, U9); G2 / 3.8 for the dates (main stamps doneAt with the device clock, see groundRules 3.8). The browser version of the clock check is S28

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
